articles.summary: Rubrik, Inc. (NYSE: RBRK), the Security and AI Operations Company, today announced the appointment of Rakefet Russak-Aminoach to its Board of Directors. Ms. Russak-Aminoach, a globally recognized financial services leader and venture investor, brings vast digital transformation and enterprise governance experience to Rubrik as organizations face compounding cyber threats. “Financial services is one of the most aggressively targeted industries for cyber threats today. Rakefet's deep expertise in modernizing global financial systems and leading through the digital and AI transformation makes her an invaluable addition to Rubrik's Board of Directors," said Bipul Sinha, CEO, Chairman, and Co-Founder at Rubrik. Ms. Russak-Aminoach currently serves as a Managing Partner at Team8, a global venture group specializing in building, investing and scaling companies. articles.summary: Rubrik Agent Cloud now monitors every agent and MCP server, controls access per tool call, and remediates unwanted actions Today at the Black Hat Conference, Rubrik (NYSE: RBRK), the Security and AI Operations Company, announced Rubrik Agent Identity, a powerful new AI-based solution to manage and control AI agents' access and permissions, addressing a key obstacle in enterprise agent deployment. AI agent deployments are rapidly evolving, with the potential to execute complex, automated workflows across SaaS applications, databases, and APIs at unprecedented speed and scale. Yet most organizations lack the capability to monitor and control agent access and actions at the necessary speed and scale. Rubrik Agent Identity is designed to reduce operational vulnerabilities that stem from agent identities by allowing customers to both monitor every agent and model context protocol (MCP) at runtime using AI, and to deliver just-in-time permissions per tool call.
